description: GENERATOR(ROWCOUNT => n | TIMELIMIT => s) in Snowflake's live-verified shape: the produced rows carry ZERO columns, so SELECT * over a generator fails with "SELECT with no columns" and consumers must project literals or expressions, or aggregate over the row count. ROWCOUNT controls the count exactly, including 0 and 1, and a projection is evaluated once per generated row. Converted 1:1 from functions/GeneratorTest (now retired); the TIMELIMIT => 0 test keeps the class's live exemption as skip snowflake.

skip.reason: TIMELIMIT 0 is nondeterministic on live Snowflake
